# Roz Washington (rozisfunny.com)

> Official site for Roz Washington — Los Angeles–based stand-up comedian, actor, writer, and co-host of Apollo Night L.A. radio. One of the most explosive comedians on the planet.

The site is a single-page experience covering Roz's bio, screen and stage credits, featured stand-up clips, upcoming tour dates, press quotes, and a direct booking form for event organizers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero, about Roz, featured reel, tour dates, press, and booking inquiry form.

## Sections

- [About](/#about): Bio, credits (Hump Day Comedy the Movie, Boosters LA, Pay The Lady, Apollo Night L.A., Laffaholics).
- [Reel](/#reel): Featured stand-up clips on YouTube.
- [Tour](/#tour): Upcoming dates at Improv Hollywood, Improv Houston, and Improv Brea.
- [Book](/#book): Booking inquiry form — funnyroz@gmail.com.
